announcements.title: Charity doesn't decrease wealth
announcements.content:
Please donate generously towards the masjid
جزاك الله خيرا

announcements.title: Dhikr
announcements.content:
سُبْحَانَ اللّهِ وَ بِحَمْدِهِ
سُبْحَانَ اللّهِ الْعَظِيمِ

Subhanallahi Wa Bihamdihi Subhanallahil Adzeem
These phrases can be translated as “Glory is to Allah and all praise is to Him, glorified is Allah, the Almighty.”
